question: At the live pins, (A) is the set of ledger entries carrying AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN in class_ids exactly the register that rev13 and the coverage matrix bind, with no omitted bound entry; (B) are the five entries that mention the C2 token outside class_ids correctly unbound, or do any of them state the frozen class conclusion for the class data (generic asymptotically flat vacuum); (C) does any ledger entry at all, bound or unbound, discharge the frozen C2 class conclusion?
why_this_is_not_a_rerun: rev13 (W010-F2A-C2-CONFORMANCE-REV13-01) tested D1/D2/D3 per binding over the 10 bound entries. This task tests the complement: the unbound token mentions, the completeness of the bound set against the matrix and rev13, an all-62-entry discharge screen on the assertion field, and the frozen-token-policy check. It discharges rev13 falsifiers (i) and (iii) as stated, not the per-binding direction audit.
pin_note: Every pin value above was set from the live file measurement taken at 2026-09-12T01:24:39+08:00 before any check ran; the run re-measures every pin at start and end and fails closed on any drift, so a stale or mistyped value cannot silently pass. (The rev13 result pin was corrected by measurement once, before the run, from a prefix-only draft value.)

decision_rule.COMPLETE_AND_OPEN: bound set == expected bound_ids AND mention set == expected mention_ids AND every mention has a non-empty exclusion reason AND no mention passes the assertion-field discharge screen AND the all-62 sweep finds 0 discharging entries AND all four controls behave as pre-stated AND pins stable start==end
decision_rule.BINDING_GAP: bound set differs from expected, or an entry satisfies the discharge screen for the class data
decision_rule.MENTION_MISCLASSIFIED: a mention passes the discharge screen or has no exclusion reason
decision_rule.INSTRUMENT_FAIL: any control deviates from its pre-stated behavior or a pin moves

discharge_screen.assertion_field: statement_exact only; does_not_imply, scope_caveats and unresolved are exclusion fields and never assertion evidence
discharge_screen.rule: assertion must carry a C2-or-smoother inextendibility conclusion marker AND a vacuum marker AND a genericity marker AND an asymptotic-flatness marker; any one absent => not discharging
discharge_screen.contrary_rule: assertion carries an exists-extension / naked-singularity marker => contrary-side, never discharging

controls.pre_stated: a synthetic vacuum + generic + asymptotically flat + C2-inextendibility statement must screen as discharging=true
the same statement with the vacuum marker replaced by a matter model must screen as discharging=false
a discharging sentence placed only in does_not_imply must screen as discharging=false
two in-process runs of the core must produce byte-identical canonical JSON

falsifiers: one ledger entry at ledger a1674f094979 whose assertion states the C2 class conclusion for generic asymptotically flat vacuum data (n_discharging >= 1)
one entry with AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN in class_ids that is absent from either the rev13 register or the coverage-matrix C2 theorem set
one of the five token mentions whose scope text asserts vacuum when its own statement names a matter model
one class_ids token outside the four frozen ids
one control that deviates from its pre-stated behavior, or one pin that moves between the pre- and post-measurement
non_claims: not a mathematics or physics claim and not a theorem
not a gate verdict, not a node transition, not a completion claim
not an adjudication of the rev13 per-binding D1/D2/D3 direction verdicts
not a re-review of the ledger text or of any cited source
stop_rule: write the package, emit artifact/claim/status events, run the checkpoint, exit. Read-only on every canonical file.
